content:
emily_cs: FYI — AcmePay reported a big regression in factuality after this morning's rollout. they say the model is confidently giving the wrong pricing and invented founder names.

ana_support: can you paste one of the customer's examples?

emily_cs: sure. customer excerpt: "What tier is the enterprise plan? $4/mo." (their plan is $400/mo). another reply: "Founder is Jane K." — their founder is John K. started ~2026-03-14 10:05 PST.

emily_cs: i reproduced quickly: curl to /v1/generate with model redwood-infer-alpha-3 and the same prompt -> same wrong claim.

emily_cs: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-infer-alpha-3","input":"Summarize pricing for AcmePay's enterprise offering.","max_tokens":200,"temperature":0.0}'
```
response snippet: "The enterprise plan costs $4/mo."

matt_ml: thanks. i pushed the canary earlier to optimize latency (kernel selection + quant profile). did you note any latency changes when you repro'd?

emily_cs: latencies slightly improved (~10% lower p50). no 5xxs. but token-level traces show model variant header: X-Model-Variant: q8_kernelB

sam_sre: infra check: no host CPU/GPU errors, no throttles for that tenant. i do see the deploy-bot flip at 2026-03-14T17:02:30Z.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started by matt_ml @ 2026-03-14T17:02:30Z -> 30% traffic

matt_ml: i did adjust postprocessing normalizer and kernel selection heuristics to reduce repetition. didn't expect factuality shift. possible interaction with quantization.

ana_support: customer asked for immediate rollback or a mitigation. they're unhappy and asked for an SLA credit.

matt_ml: propose: 1) reproduce deterministically on a pinned node with the old quant profile, 2) if repro holds, rollback kernel/quant profile for canary, 3) run our hallucination eval suite across recent prompts.

sam_sre: i can schedule a rollback window. will need a CR and confirmation. also noticed a short auth spike (401s) from that tenant at 10:07 — any chance retries truncated context and caused prompt mismatch?

emily_cs: customer logs show a couple of retry 401s around 10:07 but most of their requests are 200s. when i repro locally with same prompt and full context i still see the wrong claim.

matt_ml: ok i'll run ablation: q8_kernelB vs previous q4_kernelA, and with/without the new normalizer. will report differences in ~45m.

ana_support: i'll update the customer with we are investigating and offer temporary mitigation (pin to previous model id if they'd like).

emily_cs: customer is requesting a pinned version ASAP. i have their model_id snippets: 3b9c-7f2a-ephemeral. they can be moved to a pinned endpoint if we approve.

matt_ml: if we can't reproduce in dedicated envs, escalate to research for deeper kv-cache/kernel interaction analysis.

sam_sre: noted. prepping rollback playbook now.

ana_support: thanks all — i'll also capture the exact customer prompt, response, and timestamps into the ticket. putting owner on this: @matt_ml for root cause, @sam_sre for rollback coordination, @emily_cs for customer comms.

emily_cs: thanks — customer wants status update within 2 hours. i'm on it.
